provenance: Original procedural minor-mode score. Synthesized in memory by audio/music_director.gd; no external recording, commercial song, or borrowed melody.

rules.fixed: Boss attack windups are dispatched only by beat signals.
rules.random: Loop until health threshold queues advance; transition only at the end of a complete 16-beat phrase.
rules.rest: Both sides cannot deal damage; cancel pending attacks and clear hostile projectiles on entry.
rules.parry: Collision/contact and a short input window only. Missing a music beat never deals damage.
